findings.problem: None — the candidate repairs the audited blocker. The trusted finalizer failed again at step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' in run 35445913329 (run_number 28) with steps 5 (product/privacy/cost gates incl. iOS export and assembleRelease) and 6 (APK locate/hash) succeeding. Step 7 ran 13:51:13Z-14:12:47Z (~21.5 min) — the same long-running E2E signature as the previous six emulator-step failures, i.e. boot and install succeed while UI dumps are slow/failing and waitFor budgets are exhausted. The previous cycle (35441953837) fixed the exec-out cat path (ETIMEDOUT under cold-start load); this cycle fixes the remaining dump-failure source: uiautomator dump itself can take 30-60s on a loaded API 35 x86_64 emulator, so the 30s default shell() timeout killed it, each dumpUi failure costing ~96s (3x30s attempts + reconnects) and exhausting the 240s Demarrer window after only ~2 iterations. Repair: shell() gains a trailing { timeoutMs } options override; uiautomator dump timeout raised to 60s; launch cold-start wait 30s->45s with a post-cold-start adb reconnect; package-manager settle 30s->45s; screenshot fallback switched from exec-out cat to shell cat; waitFor/dumpUi timeout paths now capture dumpsys activity top + pidof process state + pre-E2E logcat so the next cycle can distinguish 'app crashed' from 'dump too slow' if the failure persists. All new waits are bounded (60s dump, 45s launch, 45s settle, 15s dumpsys, 10s logcat, 10s/15s reconnect), all positive assertions are unchanged, and the golden path still requires the real UI nodes to appear — a genuinely broken app cannot pass spuriously.
